task_phase_and_debt.status: Astra semantic decision; nested group implementation and real Pending-to-cancel acceptance remain open
rules: Identify each actual owner with allocation token and replacement generation; same variable/frame/type is insufficient.
Blocking FnMut can export Closed only when every reachable normal exit proves the actual captured Task closed.
Polling FnMut needs a conditional result relation tying actual canonical close-poll Ready tag to the same head and occupant generation.
Closed is not NoExternal and does not release retained ports or parents. Destroy retires responsibility and releases them.
Nested cleanup keeps one affine debt at the root with actual typed leaf paths, active tags/flags and a cleanup cursor; never discharge both leaf and whole shell.
Pending retains owner registry node, parent storage, active child responsibility and continuation PC. Actual Ready permits unlink and the specified destruction order.
Moving Managed<Task> unlink after a possibly-Pending drop is the correct narrow repair; the quarantine pending/cancel interleaving must still execute before acceptance.
